gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters generously so nothing bumps, and its tall lowercase makes each word look sturdy. Oxanium heads it with unbroken monoline strokes, commanding and distinctive.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-multani: Distinct and modern: Oxanium keeps bold, unbroken monoline strokes up top, while Noto Sans Multani rises tall below. Multani's e has a wide gap at the terminal, which lets lines breathe.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Clean is the first impression, with Oxanium drawing every stroke under constant pen pressure. And Noto Sans Myanmar sets a thick, heavy-looking band of text with a broad c.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Oxanium draws unshaded, constant strokes with a high x-height. Noto Sans Nabataean, a sans-serif with lowercase standing almost cap-tall, would read in a steady, sturdy rhythm across paragraphs of text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Tall and unshaded: Oxanium keeps its curves at full thickness through every turn. Noto Sans Nushu holds its terminals well away from the stroke and rises on a towering x-height.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails back from the body, so words read as solid blocks. And Oxanium's diagonals match its horizontals, so heading and text feel cut from one cloth.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ar: Neon-glass loud: Oxanium's heading strokes keep a tubing thickness that never wavers. Noto Sans Old North Arabian then packs in a dense, tall lowercase band, its terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Noto Sans Old Permic keeps rounded forms open to the side, against the bent-tubing letters of Oxanium. Noto Sans Old Permic reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Friendly and chunky, Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps its open-mouthed curves clear and generous beneath Oxanium's ballpoint-plain line. Paragraphs would move along smoothly on its sturdy, tall lowercase, line after line.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya turns its s shapes in wide, easy bends, and its lowercase looks oversized beside its own capitals. Oxanium's thin-free, swell-free strokes give the headings a matching steadiness.
